statements.status_notes: Docker Scout's CVE claim check classifies CVE-2026-42577 as Remediated for netty-transport-native-epoll 4.1.133.Final as of 2026-05-18 (the PR claim check lists it in the Remediated column, not under Addressed via VEX). The upstream advisory text still cites the fix as netty 4.2.13.Final, which would normally indicate the 4.1.x line is unfixed; the most plausible explanation is that Scout's vulnerability database was updated to no longer apply the CVE to the 4.1.x release line because the affected epoll-native code paths were not present there. This file is dormant - it predates Scout's reclassification and is preserved as a paper trail. If a future scan re-introduces the finding for 4.1.x, append a new statement reverting to under_investigation.
